condition.title: Overall condition
condition.basis: Based only on the saved governed risk band. Compliance and enforcement are shown separately and are never inferred.

sections.availableInProfile: This section is available in the full factory profile.

inspectionHistory.title: Inspection history
inspectionHistory.body: Approved and submitted inspection records, immutable versions and report outcomes.

violations.title: Violations & enforcement
violations.body: Violation, corrective-action and penalty records attached to approved inspection evidence.

industrial.title: Industrial information
industrial.body: Products, materials, production lines, machinery and source reconciliation.

documents.title: Documents & media
documents.body: Governed factory documents and official media, separated from inspection evidence.

change.first: Only one risk calculation is recorded, so there is no movement to show.
change.none: No risk calculation has been recorded for this factory.

advisory.title: AI assistant
advisory.evidence: Generated from this factory’s recorded risk score, band, model version and stored drivers.
advisory.idle: No advisory has been generated for this factory yet.
advisory.confidenceUnavailable: The provider returns no calibrated confidence score, so none is shown.

outlook.title: Risk outlook

outlook.driversUnavailable: No driver breakdown was recorded for this score. The absence is preserved, not reconstructed.
